Messages.Author: brandonsantacruz
Messages.Body:
If a blocking minion with a meat hook enters combat and Frenzy is
played, is the opposing vampire prohibited from striking to destroy
the meat hook in the first round? Does the strike to destroy it count
as "using" the equipment?

Thanks,

Brandon

Meat Hook
Equipment
Melee weapon.
Strike: strength+1 damage, only usable once each round. Once each
combat, if this weapon is used to strike at close range and the
opponent doesn't dodge the strike, the bearer gets an optional press
this round, only usable to continue combat. At close range, a vampire
with Potence [pot] may destroy this weapon as a strike with first
strike that costs 1 blood.

Frenzy
Master: out-of-turn. Frenzy.
Only usable before range is chosen. Choose a vampire in combat. In
this round, that vampire cannot use equipment and cannot use presses
to end combat. This round has a press, only usable to continue combat.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Dec 16, 7:50 pm, brandonsantacruz <brandonsantac...@yahoo.com>
wrote:

> If a blocking minion with a meat hook enters combat and Frenzy is
> played, is the opposing vampire prohibited from striking to destroy
> the meat hook in the first round?

No.

> Does the strike to destroy it count
> as "using" the equipment?

Yes, for the vampire striking to destroy it.

That is, if the vampire opposing the Meat Hook bearer is prohibited
from using weapons, then xe cannot strike to destroy the Meat Hook.
